title.label: Crash to Home Screen fixed, seems to be good again!

content.label:
The random crash to Home Screen & app not remembering position between pauses, or navigation away from the app bugs seem to have been fixed as of 11th Dec 24. Once again, goes from 1* to 5*!! 

The app is the best podcast app out there full stop… when it works. Now and again there’s an update that breaks something. Apparently it’s only 1 man that makes this, so eh… cut him some slack. He does fix it when he gets time.

title.label: Been a big fan from the start

content.label: This app never disappoints and I’ve been using it for free for five years. The developer just posted an update and I’ve been so impressed with how well this app works on the free version that I decided to pay the 19.99 Canadian per yearly. What a great deal that is! Download this app today and support the developer. You won’t be disappointed.
At any point in any podcast, playback stops and switches to another podcast. This is not usable at this time.

I saved 28 hours with smart speed alone!

Edit: now 79!
The best podcast app. Simple. Never using anything else ever again.
I’ve used it since day one and very much love it. Clean interface, intuitive design, and great features. It’s the best!
Good feature like voice boost and smart speed . So far no issues and bugs . Using  premium version Would like to have a equalizer options some podcast sound thin on phone speakers (iPhone 13)

This is my favourite podcast app- I love how you use it for the most part, and it has a great iPad app, which is what I usually use to listen. Update: I love the new update - thank you for bringing back the left swipe green download button!

Now I cannot scroll the chapter list without jumping to whatever chapter I had to touch for scrolling!
How could this slip quality control?

title.label: Streaming non downloaded content still creates issues

content.label:
I used this app religiously every day for seven years however something has happened to the ability to stream non-downloaded content. In the latest overhaul, I believe this was addressed by limiting playback until downloads were fully downloaded. However, that was rolled back after a number of requests to bring it back. Ever since then it still hasn’t worked properly.

After five attempts yesterday in my car to get a podcast to play and it skipping to the next episode because playing the existing episode while it was downloading wasn’t working I finally just rage quit and deleted the app. 

I love independent and smaller apps and I’ve especially loved this app for years but this portion of the app is extremely broken. Will check back in in a year.

I’ve been using Overcast for years, and I have appreciated Marco’s development through the classic version and his latest version, built from the ground up. Marco responded quickly to a few re-implementation requests; there were a few ”nitpicky” things I enjoyed about the classic version that Marco kindly put back in the latest update along with what I believe to many other people’s asks (*streaming! 😳😏😌) I hope to support Marco & Overcast as much as I can. Thank you, Marco, for your efforts and for continuing to improve a fantastic podcast app!

I’ve been a paying premium customer for years because this was the best podcast app I had come across. It used to work so well with zero issues and I would have given it 5 stars without question. A few months ago they did a major update that completely ruined the app. I’ve given it a few months to get back to the great app it used to be but it remains broken. When the initial problems began I sent a long thoughtful message to the developers with my concerns and recommendations, I never received a reply and none of the issues were corrected. I’ve cancelled my premium membership and am now transitioning all of my podcast listening to Spotify. Spotify is great.

I may not be a hardcore podcast listener, but this app doesn’t what I want and features like Smart Speed and Voice Boost are great. Whenever I find another podcast on another source like YouTube, not having Voice Boost is terrible. 

The app rewrite did change a lot of stuff but fixes came in pretty quickly. People dumping on this app for missing features on a new release have every right to be upset, but a lot has been addressed in a pretty short span of time. 

Honestly, this app is great and is the best podcast solution for me.

I’ve been using Overcast for the last number of years, and it has been really great. 

Recently, the app would make me go through submenus to download it to my phone.
Now I can use a quick gesture to download (swipe right), and this app is great again. Thanks.
After recent update, the app constantly stops playing in the background even any other app uses system audio. This was never an issue before.
Lots of crashing lately :(

The automatic playlist containing all downloaded podcasts in order of date of release is very helpful to have.

I do wish there was a summary at the top of how many episodes and play time the playlist represents - then I can easily see if I’ve got enough for a flight or drive when I can’t be downloading additional episodes.
I used Apple Podcasts for a month and am happy to return to overcast. It plays podcasts reliably and saves my place in the podcast. All the little bugs seem ironed out. Best podcast app!
This has been my favourite podcast app for years.
I have tried a few podcast apps and have settled on Overcast because it is easy to set up and use. It just works the way I want it to. No clutter just a simple interface that is so easy to customize.

I’ve been using Overcast for years until the recent big update which brings tons of bugs and app failures. 

I’ve redownloaded the app, submitted logs and emailed the dev. He does care and even mentioned on X that he’s going to increase prices. 

Time to jump ship.
Downloads fail constantly. So many buggy UI annoyances. App used to be near perfect. Now it’s near unusable.

title.label: Recent updates have ruined this app

content.label: Been using this app for 7+ years, and loved it.  Since the most recent round of updates the app is nearly unusable.  Podcasts no longer download in the background consistently when connected to wifi, streaming pods is not realistically possible as they keep pausing every 30 seconds. Really sad to see, I will be looking for an alternative app until they get it fixed.

title.label: Best Podcast App, Outstanding UI & Customization

content.label: A fantastic app that, even after all these years, is smartly improving.
Was the best. What happened Marco?

Heard this was a good alternative podcast app so I thought I'd try it. But something is fundamentally wrong: 

There's no podcasts.

Search returns no results. Adding a podcast url manually returns the message "check your internet connection". Clearly I'm connected, I just downloaded the app and I'm streaming podcasts on another app. 

Bad first impression, not sure what's wrong.

title.label: Recent updates have made this excellent app unusable

content.label:
I’ve been using this app for 5+ years and thoroughly enjoyed the experience but the recent updates have made it functionally unusable. 

Episodes constantly fail to download, even when I prompt them manually and then if you try to stream them it will exit the episode upon the first ad break and lose your place. 

Unless you painstakingly babysit an entire playlists worth of episodes into downloading forget about using this app for a road trip etc. 

Very frustrated with this turn of events and will have to look into different app options moving forward.

title.label: Overcast is still king off the hill

content.label: I had a little trouble to adapt to the new GUI, but I’ve adapted. I found a notable improvement in the watch App. I lost my iPhone and rely solely on my iPad. Previously the Watch App was horrible. Synced playlist would take forever to go to your watch. Now even without my iPhone I can sync a playlist defined on the iPad Pro I have. It sync so much faster and you do not have to have it chaging and wait an ungodly length of time for them to appear on my watch. The only thing missing would be the ability to have my watch control the version of Overcast installed on my iPad. As of now My watch communicate with iPad to retrieve my playlists and also my podcast list. The only snag is when I try to play episodes on my iPad using the watch to control playback. It doesn’t see my iPad showing only a phone icon. So I have to play episodes ohm from my watch exclusively. Could you add a preference to specify which Apple device you want your watch to control overcast ? It would be perfect for me.
Does everything I need. Love the smart speed and voice boost.

Loved the app since moving away from Pocket Casts years ago. This latest rewrite has been rocky, but I think things feel pretty close to done. 

Two last annoyances remaining from my perspective:
1: Can’t reorder podcast feeds!!! When dragging, they drop into place but jump back down after a brief moment. Very frustrating when you’ve got a lot of feeds in your list (about 26 just in my  pinned list!)
2: Still getting enormous unwanted storage usage (tens of GB), despite setting downloads to Manual. But, hopefully my latest reinstall fixes that. 

Please, if you read this review, consider looking at the feed reordering issue in the near term. 

Thanks for the hard work!

title.label: Where did all the podcasts go?

content.label: Prior to today I was always able to find a new podcast and listen to ALL the previous podcasts. As of today I am now limited to the last 100 podcasts and that’s it. Super lame.

title.label: Amazing, but missing a few features

content.label:
Overcast has a lot of amazing features like smart speed, etc. But here are a few features that I would like.

1. Transcripts: You’d be able to read along with the podcast or search for words or sentences to seek to that in the podcast.

2. Swipe Off: The option to turn off swiping from the icon of the podcast to the show Notes and settings for speed.

3. Pause/Unpause: pausing and unpause Ing for some reason takes a second or two. If this is a bug, can you please fix it?

4. Episode History: The ability to see episodes you’ve seen in the past. Like, maybe it would say, “Cortex: ep. 102 yesterday at 2:43 PM” or something like that.

Have been using Overcast for years and their latest overhaul completely broke the app for me. It’s unusable now and refuses to play an entire podcast, download them correctly, amongst many other issues. Too bad as it was the best before this.
The new build is finally usable with minor bugs.
I’ll be looking for another podcast app. I listen to 4-5 hours of podcasts a day. I loved the original format, and recommended it to anyone who asked. I am completely frustrated by the new version.
I updated my 1 star review as promised. Thanks
It's working almost perfectly now. Thanks

The redesign in August was at first a little rough but the improvements since then have helped tons! I’m very glad I was patient I’m excited to see the future updates and improvements. Still one of the best features which has saved me so many times is “go back” where I can rewind back to the part of the podcast I was on after accidentally swiping the time forward

I’ve been using Overcast since 2014, and honestly I can never go back. I paid then, and continue to pay with a subscription. 

I love the new interface, especially after sitting down and building playlists. I’ve never set those up before!! They are wonderful!

Marco’s done a good careful job keeping the app modern as the years go on. Happy to be a subscriber and will continue to do so. 

I kinda wish it was available for family sharing tho so I can let my partner benefit like I do. But that’s a minor quibble; I’ve subscribed twice. Go download!
I’ve been using Overcast for years and Marco continues to make the best podcast app experience. Not just on iOS but the best in general.

title.label: The GoT Season 8 of Podcast Apps

content.label: Never have I seen such a spectacular implosion of a once-great app. Akin to GoT’s final episodes. App crashes constantly and loses your place. New episodes appear for a second but then vanish into the ether before your very eyes. Episodes from playlists you have painstakingly added over the course of years abruptly abscond without a trace.  I have tried so hard to stick with it, but the app seems to be actually getting worse since the major rewrite. It’s completely unusable now, and I can’t trust it with my data anymore.  So sad…

I'm a big fan of this app and its new look. But there is a bug lately with the podcast updates. First, these don't appear anymore in the "Current" thread. Second, in the "All" thread, these are not highlighted, but marked like if already downloaded when these are not indeed. You have to cancel then redownload for this one to be effective. Anyway, thanks for getting back an independent order setting for those two treads. But there is something wrong with the new podcast management.

title.label: The only podcast player I’m willing to use

content.label: This app is simple, flexible, fast. The developer is responsive and considerate. Every single time I try to use a different podcast app, I’m quickly running back to Overcast because it just works.
Love this app, but it needs a Queuing feature and OPML support!
I love the new revamped app. It has clearly laid the foundation for new features and iteration for the next decade of my favourite podcast player.
Simple and intuitive it makes organizing and listening intuitive and easy. The recent redesign took a few days to get used to but I definitely prefer it.

title.label: New Look with a lot more to offer

content.label: I’ve been a happy (and paying) customer for many years and the functionality in this overhaul & update is wonderful.  The solo developer is still very actively working on all the feedback from the community and is addressing any bugs at a breakneck pace.  Everyone should give Overcast a shot… especially for listing to ATP.
I haven't tried many podcast apps and tbh I don't feel the need to. Overcast started off good and keeps getting better.

title.label: The single best app I use every day

content.label: Cannot stress how much better this app is than other podcast apps. Far and away my most used app every day. Works great, updated frequently and accurately. Developer cares about the app’s users and is thoughtful about features.
I've been using Overcast for years. It's super easy to navigate and the controls are excellent. Love love love it.
